threat_event: E-commerce skimming: malicious script injected into the hosted payment page captures card data entered by consumers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No inventory, authorization, or integrity check of payment page scripts; no change- and tamper-detection on the page
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 hosted payment page; about 1,600 e-commerce merchants
existing_controls: Web application firewall; pull-request approval for code changes
treatment_plan: Script inventory with written justification; subresource integrity and a content security policy; page change- and tamper-detection with alerts to the on-call engineer

threat_event: Stolen code repository or pipeline credential used to push malicious code into the CDE (software supply chain)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Three former contractors kept active repository tokens; pipeline deploys to production after one approval; no review of repository access
regulatory_driver: PCI DSS 6.5; PCI DSS 7.2.4; PCI DSS 8.2
existing_controls: Pull-request approval; single sign-on for workforce repository accounts
treatment_plan: Revoke all personal access tokens and move to short-lived tokens; two approvals for CDE deployments; signed build artifacts; quarterly repository access review

threat_event: Card data exfiltration goes undetected for weeks because alerts are not watched after hours and outbound traffic is not inspected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Alerts monitored in business hours only; no intrusion detection on egress; no detection of covert channels such as DNS tunneling
regulatory_driver: PCI DSS 10.4.1; PCI DSS 11.5.1.1; C-FINANCIAL-R01 (12 CFR 53.4)
existing_controls: SIEM collects CDE logs; EDR and runtime protection
treatment_plan: 24x7 monitoring by a managed detection and response service; egress DNS and network intrusion detection in the cloud tenant; after-hours on-call rotation

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over merchant portal accounts and issues fraudulent refunds or keys stolen cards into the virtual terminal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Merchant users sign in with a password only; MFA optional (14% use it); no forced password change or risk-based sign-in analysis
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 merchant portal and virtual terminal
existing_controls: Account lockout after 6 failures; refund limits per merchant
treatment_plan: Require MFA for all merchant users with refund or virtual terminal rights; risk-based sign-in analysis; alert on refund spikes

threat_event: PAN stored outside the CDE in support tickets and email is exposed through a SaaS account compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Merchants paste card numbers into tickets and email; no PAN discovery; ticketing and email are not in the CDE
existing_controls: MFA on SaaS accounts
treatment_plan: Automatic PAN masking in the ticketing system and email; quarterly PAN discovery scans; procedure for PAN found outside the CDE

threat_event: Cloud region or platform failure stops authorizations for more than 4 hours
threat_source: Cloud provider regional failure or failed deployment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Platform runs active in one region; failover to the second region is not built out or tested; no platform recovery runbook
existing_controls: Multi-zone deployment in the primary region; snapshots copied to a second region
treatment_plan: Warm standby in the second region for the authorization path; recovery runbook; semiannual failover test

threat_event: Ransomware on office laptops spreads to corporate SaaS and file shares and halts support and settlement operations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Office network flat; file shares synced to laptops
existing_controls: EDR on all laptops; MFA; CDE reachable only through the bastion
treatment_plan: Isolate settlement workstations on their own network segment; versioned SaaS backups

threat_event: Settlement database corruption cannot be recovered in time, so merchant funding files are late or wrong
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Restores not tested since migration; no documented recovery procedure
existing_controls: Daily snapshots copied to a second region; point-in-time recovery enabled
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore test of the settlement database; recovery runbook; reconciliation check after each restore

threat_event: Support or operations staff harvest card numbers from tickets or the virtual terminal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PAN visible in tickets; broad support roles in the merchant portal
existing_controls: Background checks; portal masks PAN on display
treatment_plan: Remove PAN from tickets (R-005); least-privilege support roles; monthly review of support access logs

threat_event: Cloud service accounts with broad standing privileges are abused after one workload is compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Service accounts not reviewed; several have administrator-level roles
existing_controls: Human administrators use hardware keys through the bastion
treatment_plan: Inventory service accounts; scope each role to its function; semiannual review

threat_event: A former employee or contractor uses access that was not removed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Termination checklist covers single sign-on only; tokens, API keys, and SaaS local accounts missed
existing_controls: Single sign-on disabled on the last day
treatment_plan: Termination checklist covering tokens and local accounts; quarterly reconciliation of all accounts to HR

threat_event: Segmentation between the corporate network and the CDE fails after the cloud migration, exposing the CDE
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Segmentation not penetration tested since migration; network rules changed during cut-over
existing_controls: Bastion-only admin access; network rules reviewed at cut-over
treatment_plan: Segmentation penetration test now and every six months; network rule review every six months

threat_event: Failure of log forwarding or another critical security control goes unnoticed, leaving blind spots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No alerting on failed log sources, stopped agents, or disabled rules (9-day gap in May 2026)
existing_controls: Weekly manual glance at SIEM dashboards
treatment_plan: Alerts for silent log sources, stopped EDR agents, and web application firewall rule changes; response procedure

threat_event: 2026 ROC finds requirements not in place, producing a non-compliant AOC and sponsor bank remediation demands
threat_source: Card brands and sponsor bank (compliance program)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Scope not reconfirmed; several v4.0 requirements effective 2025-03-31 not operating after the migration
existing_controls: 2025 AOC Compliant; QSA relationship
treatment_plan: Close P03 High gaps before 2026-11-02; readiness check with the QSA in October

threat_event: Required notices are late: card brand 3-day notice, sponsor bank notice under 12 CFR 53.4, FTC notice under 16 CFR 314.4(j)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2023 plan has no notice clocks; bank-designated contacts not recorded
existing_controls: Cyber insurer breach counsel panel
treatment_plan: Updated POL-03 and P08 runbook with a notification matrix; record the sponsor bank's contacts; annual tabletop

threat_event: A service provider with CDE access (fraud model vendor, content delivery service) is compromised and exposes data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No responsibility matrix; current AOCs missing for 2 of 6 providers
existing_controls: Contracts with confidentiality terms
treatment_plan: Collect AOCs or include providers in the ROC; responsibility matrix per provider; annual review

threat_event: Misuse or compromise of cryptographic keys that protect stored PAN
threat_source: Privileged insider or attacker with HSM administrator access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Key custodian procedures written in 2023 for the old hosting; no key custodian review since the move to the payment HSM service
existing_controls: FIPS 140-3 Level 3 HSM service; dual control and split knowledge for key ceremonies
treatment_plan: Update key-management procedures for the HSM service; key custodian acknowledgments; annual key ceremony review

threat_event: Phishing captures a non-administrator's password and MFA approval (push fatigue)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standard users use push-based MFA without number matching
existing_controls: Annual training with phishing module; email filtering
treatment_plan: Number matching or phishing-resistant MFA for all users; quarterly phishing exercises

threat_event: Denial-of-service attack against the API gateway degrades authorizations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing API
existing_controls: Content delivery service with DDoS protection; rate limits
treatment_plan: Accepted by COO: residual risk Low; provider DDoS protection reviewed annually

threat_event: Fraud model drift causes a spike in false declines of legitimate transactions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No monitoring of decline rates or false positives by segment; thresholds set once at deployment
existing_controls: Merchants can whitelist customers; fraud analysts review escalations
treatment_plan: Daily decline-rate and false-positive monitoring; rollback threshold; quarterly model validation (see P10)

threat_event: Fraud model declines or challenges some cardholder groups (for example prepaid card users or particular regions) at unjustified higher rates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No fairness testing; features include BIN country, card type, and billing ZIP code
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Segment-level testing before each quarterly model update (see P10 bias plan)

threat_event: Fraud model training extract sent to the vendor is exposed or used beyond the contract
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Extract not minimized; vendor's use limits not reviewed
existing_controls: Extract uses tokens, not PAN (by design)
treatment_plan: Minimize the extract; contract clause limiting use to the company's model; deletion certificate after each retraining

threat_event: Staff paste merchant or transaction details into public generative AI chatbots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list; no training on generative AI
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Approved-tools list; enterprise AI tool with no-training terms; block public chatbots on managed laptops (see P10)

threat_event: Hurricane closes the Florida office and disrupts settlement and support staff for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: All staff in one office; settlement tasks run from office laptops
affected_asset_or_process: Florida office; settlement and support processes
existing_controls: Laptops and SaaS allow remote work; platform is in the cloud
treatment_plan: Remote-work procedures for settlement; staff roster outside the storm path

threat_event: Fraudster changes a merchant's funding bank account through the portal or by social engineering support, diverting settlement funds
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank account changes in the portal need only the user's password; support can change accounts after caller ID questions
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03; SYS-01 funding engine; merchant support
existing_controls: Change confirmation email to the merchant
treatment_plan: Step-up MFA and a 3-business-day hold with call-back for funding account changes

threat_event: A known vulnerability in an open-source component of the platform is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Dependency scanning covers only the API gateway; no inventory of bespoke software components
existing_controls: Quarterly internal authenticated scans; monthly container image rebuilds
treatment_plan: Dependency scanning on all repositories; software component inventory; 30-day patch window for critical findings

threat_event: FTC enforcement after a breach because Safeguards Rule elements were missing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written report to the owner by the Qualified Individual; incident response plan lacks required elements
existing_controls: Information Security Lead designated
treatment_plan: Qualified Individual designation in writing; annual written report to the CEO and COO; plan elements in POL-03

threat_event: Security program stalls because it depends on one part-time person
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IT Manager holds security, PCI, and IT duties; security engineer role vacant since April 2026
existing_controls: QSA and insurer panel available
treatment_plan: Hire a security engineer; document PCI DSS responsibilities per requirement (12.1.3)

threat_event: Theft of a workforce laptop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops travel
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe; no card data on laptops
treatment_plan: Accepted by IT Manager: residual risk Low

threat_event: Cloud console administrator account taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Nine administrators with standing access
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant hardware keys for all administrators; bastion-only CDE access
treatment_plan: Accepted by COO: residual risk Low

threat_event: Full card numbers left in a data warehouse table outside PCI DSS controls are accessed by analysts or an attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Faulty extract job wrote about 2.3 million unencrypted PANs to a training table (found in P07 testing); warehouse not in PCI DSS scope
regulatory_driver: PCI DSS 3.5.1; PCI DSS 12.10.7; PCI DSS 12.5.2.1
existing_controls: Warehouse access limited to 11 analysts and engineers with single sign-on
treatment_plan: Table purged 2026-08-07; fix the extract job; monthly PAN discovery on the warehouse; access log review for the exposure window
